hypotheses.name: Fixed-Voronoi observed-sample representative control
hypotheses.hypothesis: At fixed draw cloud, partition, K and network, replacing continuous cluster means with a within-cell observed representative may change coverage and downstream paths; effect unverified
hypotheses.partitions: freeze final-center Voronoi assignment of original10000 draws; no reclustering
hypotheses.representative: argmin_{p in assigned existing draws} sum_{q in same cell} ||q-p||^2; ties lowest original draw index
hypotheses.empty_cell: retain original center; current final-cell audit has zero empty cells
hypotheses.duplicates: retain repeated draws and duplicate representatives; report effective distinct goals; no ad hoc filling
deploy_inputs: original history and semantics only for frozen decoder
hypotheses.novelty: ordinary squared-medoid control; NOT a proposed original algorithm
hypotheses.fairness: same998 IDs/history/GT/weights/K20/head0; baseline original cache immutable; alternative output in separate directory
hypotheses.decode: Any changed Goal MUST be sent through frozen original Path Decoder; old20 paths cannot stand in for changed Goals
metrics: radius mass coverage under fixed p

provisional_success_rule.interpretation: development engineering gate only, not original-method or independent-generalization proof

hypotheses.failure_rule: If these fail, reject this single representative-control hypothesis; no medoid/FPS/radius/seed sweep or additional training
hypotheses.confirmation: Before any SCI claim reserve genuinely unaccessed source recording(s), disjoint from baseline training/development and sealed test. Metadata-only feasibility check first; if unavailable report limitation. Do not repurpose sealed test autonomously.
hypotheses.approval: Requires a new user instruction and separate frozen protocol before execution
hypotheses.costs: No training; CPU representative control not measured. Priorstage decoder mean0.124399s/target (~124.15s/998), excludes startup/I/O; not a new timing result.

reason: Only a conventional control is justified; no distinct new mathematics or independent confirmation evidence
